name: science-study-evaluator
description: Check whether a scientific study, or the news story about it, holds up: verify the citation, read the paper itself, check conflicts of interest, measure how far the headline outruns the findings, and get a five-level verdict with the reasoning explained in plain language. Ships a standard-library Python script that pulls Crossref, Unpaywall, PubMed and Europe PMC in one call. Evergreen: the appraisal checklist refreshes itself from primary sources.
